title: Russian Culinary Culture
summary: Russian: dill and sour cream, potatoes, butter.
origins: Russian cuisine reflects europe geography, trade routes, and home cooking traditions passed through generations.
history: Technique-driven cooking — fond, butter, wine reductions, and respect for seasonal produce.
teaching: Build depth with fond from searing, reduce wine and stock, finish with cold butter for shine.
Keep mirepoix components, good butter, and wine vinegar on hand.
Signature pairing: dill and sour cream + potatoes + butter.
